concept.reason: True neotype photos and published adult anatomical description sufficient; no extra concept images.

scope: Whole adult animal with small head, slender elongated neck and markedly unequal forelimb/hindlimb lengths. Not embryo, partial skeleton or a generic heavy quadrupedal sauropod.

scientific_limits.en: Artistic whole-animal reconstruction, not fossil scan. Adult neotype BP/1/4934 preserves skull, neck, trunk and forelimb but lacks most hindlimbs and tail. Those missing regions and pose/soft tissue are inferred from adult anatomical evidence. Four metres is an approximate species-level display scale, not measured neotype total.
scientific_limits.zh: 完整成年活体美术复原，非化石扫描。成年新模 BP/1/4934 保留头颈躯干和前肢，但缺大部分后肢与尾；缺失部分、姿态及软组织依据成年解剖资料复原。4米为约定估算展示尺度，非新模全长实测。

scale.basis: NHM approximate genus length; Wits reports adults up to about5m. Not exact neotype measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Small short box-like skull on a long slender neck, not hatchling oversized head.
Short grasping forelimbs and distinctly longer weight-bearing hindlimbs; chosen adult bipedal stance.
Full muscular tapering tail balances trunk; no short embryo tail.
Neck extends gently forward, not the extreme curved burial arrangement in Figure1.
Palms face inward with modest grasping digits; no forced downward pronation or columnar sauropod forefeet.
specimen_basis: Barrett etal2019 Figure1A-B BP/1/4934 actual photographs visually inspected. Adult established by histology, incomplete hindlimbs/tail explicitly acknowledged. Wits2005 adult ontogeny summary supports long neck/small head/short forelimbs/long hindlimbs.
acceptance_checks: Side view clearly preserves small head/long slender neck and strong adult limb-length contrast.
Whole adult retained, with both short arms, both long hindlimbs and complete tapering tail.
No embryo proportions, heavy sauropod quadruped substitution or copied burial-neck kink.
Four standard views only; independent QA must evaluate original silhouette, not only count objects.
